LESSON: WEATHER AND SKY ITS RESOURCES

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: Environment and
Topic 1.1: Weather and Sky its resources

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Weather and Sky its resources. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. observe differences in appearance of the sky during the day and at night
2. develop curiosity in observing appearance of the sky for enjoyment. computer games on the Sun, moon, clouds and stars Sun, moon, clouds and stars.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. observe differences in appearance of the sky during the day and at night
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to observe differences in appearance of the sky during the day and at night. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. develop curiosity in observing appearance of the sky for enjoyment. computer games on the Sun, moon, clouds and stars Sun, moon, clouds and stars.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to develop curiosity in observing appearance of the sky for enjoyment. computer games on the Sun, moon, clouds and stars Sun, moon, clouds and stars. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Weather and Sky its resources.
2. Explain Weather and Sky its resources to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: You should play educative computer games on the Sun, moon, clouds and stars
4. Show that you can: observe differences in appearance of the sky during the day and at night
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Weather and Sky its resources. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Weather and Sky its resources important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Play educative computer games on the Sun, moon, clouds and stars
2. Draw and colour the Sun, moon, clouds and stars.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. observe differences in appearance of the sky during the day and at night
2. develop curiosity in observing appearance of the sky for enjoyment. computer games on the Sun, moon, clouds and stars Sun, moon, clouds and stars.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
